sn35.61:1.4: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇam || tiṇṇaṃ saṅgatiphasso ||
sn35.61:1.6: Evam passaṃ bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmim pi nibbindati || rūpesu pi nibbindati || cakkhuviññāṇe pi nibbindati || vedanāya pi nibbindati || ||
sn35.61:1.7: Nibbindaṃ virajjati || virāgā vimuccati || Vimokkhā pariyādinnam me upādānanti pajānāti || pe || || 7-8
